description: Warm paper background, Didone serif display titles with a sturdier Georgia for body headings, gold accents and ornaments. Built for facilitators: labeled activity tags (leer / ver / analizar / meditar / actividad / informar / compromiso), timed section dividers, a live lesson-timeline footer, offline video embeds, and an on-the-fly font-size control for room readability.
features: Section timeline footer with per-section time budgets
A− / 100% / A+ on-the-fly font scaling on every slide
Keyboard, click-zone, touch and hash-link navigation
Activity tag pills + cards with color spines
Offline <video> embeds (local .mp4 next to the HTML)
name: Elegant Paper
